column1: # Exact-build rendered acceptance for all eight pending crystal actions and Middleworld.
# Red — Inferno damages and ignites a real player-compatible target.

column3: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with powers:red_crystal

column1: # Orange mode zero — exactly three bounded combat echoes.

column3: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with powers:orange_crystal
execute if entity @e[type=powers:echo_clone,distance=..10] run say CLONE_SWARM_PRESENT

column1: # Orange mode one — actual sneak-use selection and creation chamber placement.

column3: execute if block -9 103 0 minecraft:glowstone run say CREATION_CHAMBER_PRESENT
execute if block -7 101 0 minecraft:orange_concrete run say CREATION_FRAME_PRESENT

column1: # Yellow — extreme size shift and every supporting effect remains particle-free.

column3: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with powers:yellow_crystal

column1: # Violet — one linked target mirrors a bounded share of another target's damage.

column3: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with powers:violet_crystal

column1: # Blue mode zero — Chrono Stop owns and then releases the vanilla tick freeze.

column3: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with powers:blue_crystal

column1: # Blue mode one — controlled movement and the fixed spectator right-click return.
# Indigo — caster and one invulnerable vanilla mob enter and return together.

column3: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with powers:indigo_crystal
execute if dimension powers:middleworld run say MIDDLEWORLD_ENTERED
execute in powers:middleworld if entity @e[tag=qa_realm_mate,limit=1] run say REALM_MATE_ENTERED
execute in powers:middleworld as @e[tag=qa_realm_mate,limit=1] at @s run tp @s ~6 ~4 ~
execute in powers:middleworld run data get entity @e[tag=qa_realm_mate,limit=1] Pos
execute if dimension minecraft:overworld run say MIDDLEWORLD_RETURNED
execute in minecraft:overworld if entity @e[tag=qa_realm_mate,limit=1] run say REALM_MATE_RETURNED
execute in minecraft:overworld run data get entity @e[tag=qa_realm_mate,limit=1] Pos
